HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Avoiding all community work

2. Which statement about National integration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat National integration as rumours only.
   B. Explain National integration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing National integration.
   D. Say National integration never happens in Kenya.

3. Which statement about Human Developments in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Human Developments in Africa.
   B. Say Human Developments in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Human Developments in Africa as rumours only.
   D. Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. Which statement about Elections in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Elections in Kenya as rumours only.
   B. Explain Elections in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Elections in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Elections in Kenya.

5. Which statement about Colonization of Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Colonization of Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Colonization of Africa.
   C. Treat Colonization of Africa as rumours only.
   D. Explain Colonization of Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Public Participation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Public Participation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Public Participation never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Public Participation.
   D. Treat Public Participation as rumours only.

7. Which statement about Global Wars is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Global Wars.
   B. Treat Global Wars as rumours only.
   C. Say Global Wars never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Global Wars with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Establishment of colonial rule is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Establishment of colonial rule with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Establishment of colonial rule never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Establishment of colonial rule as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Establishment of colonial rule.

9. Which statement about Introduction to History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Introduction to History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Introduction to History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Introduction to History and Citizenship as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to History and Citizenship.

10. Which statement about Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence as rumours only.
   C. Explain Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence.

11. Which statement about African Civilisations up to 19th Century is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing African Civilisations up to 19th Century.
   B. Say African Civilisations up to 19th Century never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat African Civilisations up to 19th Century as rumours only.
   D. Explain African Civilisations up to 19th Century with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nairobi
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nakuru

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Establishment of colonial rule and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Public Participation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Elections in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

1. C — Obeying laws and caring for public property

2. B — Explain National integration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. D — Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. B — Explain Elections in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. D — Explain Colonization of Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. A — Explain Public Participation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. D — Explain Global Wars with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. A — Explain Establishment of colonial rule with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. A — Explain Introduction to History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. C — Explain Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. D — Explain African Civilisations up to 19th Century with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

16. (4 marks)
